text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly output (faint line) and each day's largest half-hour (dark line), in megawatts, over the 12-month study window. Horizontal lines, each labelled with its value: the five published capacities, and the dashed line, the 99th percentile of the BMU's output (a measure of output, not a capacity). TEC and REPD describe the whole Cleve Hill project, which holds both Cleve Hill BMUs and a battery.'
